units.source_text: 日色已暮，众侍女告薰中纳言：“请那边坐。”

en.t: As evening had already fallen, the ladies-in-waiting said to Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, "Please sit over there."

units.source_text: 就招待他在那里吃些泡饭等物。

en.t: They then served him there with a little rice in hot water and other light food.

units.source_text: 但薰中纳言说：“总须让我在近旁侍候。”

en.t: But Kaoru said, "Please let me stay close by and attend her."

units.source_text: 此时南厢已设有僧众座位。

en.t: By then, seats for the monks had already been arranged in the southern aisle.

units.source_text: 东面稍近大女公子病床，就在那里设个屏风，请薰中纳言入座。

en.t: On the eastern side, somewhat nearer the elder princess's sickbed, they set up a screen and invited Kaoru to sit there.

units.source_text: 二女公子觉得薰中纳言离得太近，不好意思。

en.t: The younger princess felt embarrassed, thinking that Kaoru was seated too close.

units.source_text: 但众侍女认为此人与大小姐有不可分离的深缘，对他都不疏远。

en.t: But the ladies-in-waiting believed that he and their young mistress were bound by a deep and inseparable bond, so none of them kept him at a distance.

units.source_text: 从初夜时分开始，命僧众不断地诵念《法华经》。

en.t: From the first watch of the night, the monks were ordered to recite the Lotus Sutra without pause.

units.source_text: 仅由嗓音美好的十二个僧人诵念，故其声非常庄严。

en.t: Only twelve monks with beautiful voices were chosen to chant, so the sound was exceptionally solemn.

units.source_text: 南厢内点着灯火，病室中则是黑暗的。

en.t: Lamps were lit in the southern aisle, while the sickroom itself remained dark.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言把帷屏的垂布撩起，膝行到里面去看看。

en.t: Kaoru lifted the hanging cloth of the curtain screen and crawled forward on his knees to look inside.

units.source_text: 但只见两三个老侍女伺候着。

en.t: But he saw only two or three elderly ladies-in-waiting attending her.

units.source_text: 二女公子看见薰中纳言进来，立刻回避了，故室内人数甚少。

en.t: When the younger princess saw Kaoru come in, she immediately withdrew, so there were very few people in the room.

units.source_text: 大女公子寂寞地躺卧着。

en.t: The elder princess lay there forlornly.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言对她说：“为什么你一声也不响呢？”

en.t: Kaoru said to her, "Why do you not say a single word?"

units.source_text: 便执着她的手催她说话。

en.t: He took her hand and urged her to speak.

units.source_text: 大女公子气息奄奄，断断续续地说：“我心里想说，但说时非常痛苦。

en.t: The elder princess, barely breathing, said in broken phrases, "In my heart I want to speak, but it is terribly painful to do so.

units.source_text: 多日不相见了，深恐就此死去，正在悲伤呢。”

en.t: We have not seen each other for many days, and I have been grieving, afraid that I might die like this."

units.source_text: 薰中纳言说：“我不来望你，害得你如此盼待！”

en.t: Kaoru said, "I did not come to visit you, and made you wait for me like this!"

units.source_text: 说罢号啕大哭起来。

en.t: After saying this, he began to sob aloud.

units.source_text: 大女公子头上有些发热。

en.t: The elder princess's head was somewhat feverish.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言说：“你有何罪而得此恶报呢？

en.t: Kaoru said, "What sin could you have committed to receive such cruel retribution?

units.source_text: 想是负怨于人，因而患此重病的吧。”

en.t: Perhaps you have incurred someone's resentment, and that is why you have fallen into this grave illness."

units.source_text: 他把嘴凑近大女公子耳边，说了许多话。

en.t: He brought his mouth close to the elder princess's ear and said many things to her.

units.source_text: 大女公子又是厌烦，又是羞耻，举起衣袖遮住了脸。

en.t: The elder princess was both distressed and ashamed, and raised her sleeve to cover her face.

units.source_text: 她的身体比前更见衰弱，奄奄一息地躺着。

en.t: Her body looked even weaker than before, and she lay there as if at the point of death.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言想：“如果就此死去，教我何以为心！”

en.t: Kaoru thought, "If she dies like this, how am I to bear it?"

units.source_text: 便觉肝肠欲断。

en.t: At that thought, he felt his heart would break.

units.source_text: 隔帘对二女公子说：“二小姐连日忙于看护，想必十分劳顿。

en.t: Speaking through the curtain to the younger princess, he said, "You have been busy nursing her day after day, and must be utterly exhausted.

units.source_text: 今夜请好好安息，由我担任值宿可也。”

en.t: Please rest well tonight; I will take the night watch."

units.source_text: 二女公子有些不放心，但念个中或有缘故，便退居稍远之处。

en.t: The younger princess felt somewhat uneasy, but thinking there must be some reason for it, she withdrew to a place a little farther away.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言虽然不是和大女公子面对面，但坐在很近的旁边，以便照料。

en.t: Although Kaoru did not sit facing the elder princess directly, he sat very close beside her so that he could care for her.

units.source_text: 大女公子心里既不安，又羞涩。

en.t: The elder princess felt both uneasy and shy at heart.

units.source_text: 但她想：“原来我同他有这样的宿缘！”

en.t: But she thought, "So this is the bond of fate that I have with him."

units.source_text: 她回思此人性情温厚沉着，稳重可靠。

en.t: She reflected that his nature was gentle, calm, steady, and dependable.

units.source_text: 比较起那个人来，实在优越得多。

en.t: Compared with that other man, he was truly far superior.

units.source_text: 她深恐自己死后，在此人的回忆中是一个倔强顽固、冷酷无情的人，因此并不拒远他。

en.t: She deeply feared that after her death he would remember her as stubborn, obstinate, cold, and heartless, and for that reason she did not push him away.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言通夜坐在她身旁，指挥众侍女，劝病人服汤药。

en.t: Kaoru sat beside her all night, directing the ladies-in-waiting and urging the patient to take medicinal broth.

units.source_text: 但大女公子一口也不想喝。

en.t: But the elder princess did not want to drink even a single sip.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言想：“这病势险恶了！

en.t: Kaoru thought, "This illness has taken a dangerous turn.

units.source_text: 怎样可以保住性命呢？”

en.t: How can her life be saved?"

units.source_text: 他心中怀着无限忧虑。

en.t: His heart was filled with boundless anxiety.
